name: claude-code-toolkit
description: Personal toolkit for Claude Code. Bundles a core meta-toolkit for authoring skills, sub-agents, slash commands, plugins, hooks, and CLAUDE.md memory files, plus a development plugin shipping an opinionated senior engineering team (software-developer, software-architect, code-reviewer, quality-engineer, security-engineer) with methodology-anchored skills (adr, test-plan, git-commit, mermaid) wired to the right agents.

plugins.name: claude-code-core
plugins.description: Meta-skills for authoring Claude Code extensions: scaffold, validate, and audit skills, sub-agents, slash commands, plugins, hooks, and CLAUDE.md memory files against the latest official conventions.

plugins.name: claude-code-development
plugins.description: Opinionated senior engineering team for Claude Code: software-developer (with a large-change batching protocol), software-architect, code-reviewer, quality-engineer, and security-engineer — plus methodology-anchored skills (adr, test-plan, git-commit, mermaid) wired to the right agents. Single-responsibility scope, least-privilege tooling.
